stories.title: Manistee Township joins pause on new data centers
stories.dek: Manistee Township has halted new data-center proposals, aligning with nearby townships. The move blocks large-scale projects that would draw heavy power and water in the area. Residents 30 miles away now face the same uncertainty over future industrial growth and utility rates.
stories.source_title: Manistee Township joins neighboring townships in pausing data centers - Manistee News Advocate

stories.title: Saline Twp tax break for data center faces legal challenge
stories.dek: An attorney claims Saline Township bypassed required steps when approving a tax abatement for a large data-center project. The challenge could delay or derail the deal that would shift millions in taxes away from local services. Nearby residents are watching how the fight affects their property taxes and school funding.
stories.source_title: In bid to stop Saline Data Center tax break, an attorney argues the township skipped crucial steps - Michigan Advance

stories.title: DTE eyes Milan Twp site for new gas plant to feed data-center demand
stories.dek: DTE is scouting Milan Township for a natural-gas power plant aimed at serving large new loads. Residents 30 miles away will feel the impact through higher utility rates and air-quality trade-offs if the plant is approved. The move shows how Michigan townships are being pulled into the data-center power scramble.
stories.source_title: DTE Considers Milan Township for Natural Gas Power Plant - The Sun Times News

stories.title: East Lansing keeps data-center freeze in place while writing new rules
stories.dek: City leaders extended the moratorium so staff can finish regulations on power use and setbacks. Residents 30 miles away in surrounding townships now have a model to watch for their own zoning fights. The pause blocks any new proposals until the rules are locked in.
stories.source_title: East Lansing Extends Data Center Moratorium as City Develops New Regulations - East Lansing Info

stories.title: Coldwater officials set Monday meeting on data-center power and water strain
stories.dek: Branch County leaders will hear how new facilities could affect local utility rates and aquifer levels. The joint session pulls in township and county boards to discuss oversight options. Nearby residents get a direct look at the trade-offs before any projects advance.
stories.source_title: Monday joint meeting to explore data center impacts and oversight - Coldwater Daily Reporter

stories.title: Hyperscale Data sells $43M in Bitcoin to fund Michigan data center push
stories.dek: The crypto miner turned data-center developer unloaded 685 BTC to slash $30M in debt and boost liquidity. The cash directly supports its Michigan buildout plans. Readers statewide should watch how the company’s finances shape power demand and local tax deals.
stories.source_title: Hyperscale Data Bitcoin Sale Nets $43M, Cuts Debt by $30M for Michigan Expansion - The Cryptonomist

stories.title: Lake Township caps data center water and power use
stories.dek: Lake Township is writing stricter zoning rules that would limit how much water and electricity new data centers can draw. Residents in this rural Huron County area worry large facilities could strain wells and the local grid. The draft rules come as more companies eye Michigan sites for AI servers.
stories.source_title: Lake Township drafts tougher data center rules with water and power limits - Huron Daily Tribune

stories.title: Lyon Township residents push back on data center noise and traffic
stories.dek: Hundreds of Lyon Township homeowners packed a meeting to oppose a proposed facility they say would add constant hum and truck traffic near homes. Officials heard testimony that the project could affect property values and daily life for people living within a mile. The township has not yet voted on the plan.
stories.source_title: Lyon Twp. residents respond to proposed data center - The Detroit News

stories.title: Detroit suburbs tighten zoning to block data center power spikes
stories.dek: Towns around Detroit are rewriting rules after residents complained about noise, water use and grid strain from proposed facilities. The changes would give local boards more say over size, location and utility demands. Southeast Michigan ratepayers could see higher bills if large projects connect without new safeguards.
stories.source_title: As data center issues persist, Detroit area towns look to strengthen rules - The Detroit News

stories.title: Negaunee locks in zoning rules for any future data centers
stories.dek: Negaunee City approved a new ordinance that sets where and how data centers can be built. The rules give residents clearer standards on size, noise, and power use before projects reach the planning stage. Local officials say the step prevents rushed proposals that could strain city services and the electric grid.
stories.source_title: Negaunee City passes data center zoning regulation ordinance - WZMQ 19 News

stories.title: Marshall council faces credible threats tied to data center fight
stories.dek: Police confirmed credible threats against Marshall City Council members after residents pushed back on a proposed data center. The dispute centers on power demand, noise, and tax incentives in the small Calhoun County city. Officials are weighing extra security while the project review continues.
stories.source_title: 'Credible' threats over data center dispute made against Marshall City Council - WWMT

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.
